title: Young Girl on Birthday at Trailer Park, 1961 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Sandy on her Birthday Real Cloudy day so pictures no good.
description: A vintage black and white snapshot stamped April 1961, capturing a young girl named Sandy posing outside in a frilly party dress on her birthday. She stands in a paved lot or driveway bordered by vintage travel trailers and a classic car on a cloudy day.
